text:
tess: FYI p99 token latency and kernel nvlink retries spiking in ap-south-1 since ~07:10 UTC. p99 ~3x, GPU PCIe/NVLink error counters tick up with high slab churn. suspect long-lived streaming sessions from vision-labs-prod. :eyes:
infra-bot: [ALERT] gpu_latency_anomaly: region=ap-south-1 hosts=[host-23,host-24,host-27] p99_multiplier=3.1 slab_churn_score=9.4 window=10m
dana: opened quick probe. top alloc owners on host-23: vision-labs-prod (45%), infra-proxy (12%), misc-dev (8%).
alejandro: NVLink counters look noisy. can you pull `nvlink_error_total` and `pci_retries` for those hosts? I want to see if it's cross-host DMA fallout vs local slab thrash.
tess: gimme 2m, posting graphs to https://telemetry.internal/graphs/1769998002 (flamegraph + nvlink)
sam: if it's the streaming sessions holding big pinned slabs + small frees, we see churn -> kernel slows -> dma retries -> other tenants hit p99. Need soft isolation not full kill.
maria: ops/cost question: if we move them to a dedicated lane, what's the warm-pool budget in ap-south? we have 1 warm-slice reserved there, limited for enterprise.
leo: proposal: implement a per-tenant slab soft-cap + graceful shed. Behavior: when slab_hot_ratio > threshold -> 1) reduce concurrency by X% 2) new allocs route to dedicated-burst (preemptible) pool 3) tag tenant for finance if repeated. No hard OOMs.
dana: agree. also want a cooldown to avoid oscillation. maybe cooldown 45m per tenant.
alejandro: PromQL sketch for detection (naive):
```
(sum by (tenant) (rate(gpu_slab_allocs[5m]))) / (sum by (tenant) (gpu_slab_active_bytes)) > 0.08
```
plus: `increase(nvlink_retries_total{host=~"host-.*"}[5m]) > 50` to correlate.
sam: config prototype (pseudo-yaml):
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: SoftCapRule
metadata:
  name: per-tenant-slab-softcap
spec:
  trigger:
    expr: "slab_hot_ratio>0.08 and nvlink_retries>50"
    window: 5m
  action:
    reduce_concurrency_pct: 25
    route_new_allocs: dedicated-burst-preemptible
    cooldown: 45m
    revert_after: 12m
```
tess: running canary in ap-south staging: will tag vision-labs-prod with `telemetry.tag=slab_softcap_probe` and simulate soft-cap on one host. posting flamegraph after.
alejandro: command to fetch nvlink and slab timeline: `curl -s "https://metrics.internal/query?hosts=host-23,host-24&range=15m&metrics=nvlink_error_total,pci_retries,gpu_slab_allocs"`
maria: finance note: cc @sales — if a tenant triggers >3 softcap migrations in 7 days, open contract review. we should auto-email tenant with cost impact and recommend dedicated reservation.
leo: operational guardrail: make default action only route *new* allocations to dedicated-burst to avoid interrupting in-flight sessions. reduce concurrency by request admission control, not killing workers.
dana: good. add metric tags so we can query frequency by tenant: `sum(increase(slab_softcap_triggers_total{tenant=~".*"}[30d])) by (tenant)`
sam: also add a rollback safety: if moving to dedicated-burst results in queue growth > 2x for tenant, revert and escalate to oncall instead of auto-evicting further.
oncall-bot: @oncall paging: softcap triggered for vision-labs-prod in ap-south-1. Runbook: https://internal.runbook/slab-softcap
tess: posted flamegraph link: https://telemetry.internal/graphs/1769998002/flame (shows heavy pinned alloc stacks from `stream/dense-infer`), nvlink graph at https://telemetry.internal/graphs/1769998002/nv
maria: +1 on billing leash. also consider a small surcharge for repeated preemptible moves to cover warm-pool costs.
alejandro: i'll correlate NIC QF counters and check if we saw cross-host DMA backpressure earlier today; will post findings in the thread.
dana: i'll land the PromQL to staging and a small helm patch for the SoftCapRule. aim to monitor for 6h then decide to roll to prod in ap-south. avoid making the default cooldown too short.
tess: thanks team. tagging `:shipit:` once staging green. keeping thread updated. :thumbsup:
